zircon_runtime/src/scene/tests/ecs_refle.block_audit: Read the complete 248-line fixture. Module doc assigns controlled metadata and virtual adapters; eight path submodules are mounted, but their source files are not formal R010 coverage. Registration helpers build Opaque metadata or Struct metadata with one entity/enabled field. The stable field-ID and address helpers wrap interface constructors. Component adapter factory wires name and dense-slot read/write plus remove callbacks. Name/slot reads check entity existence and only accept `entity`/slot 0; failures are UnknownField. Writes compare current read value and return changed without mutation. Remove returns entity presence only. Resource factory wires fixed contains/read/preflight and slot writes; it has no backing resource state, returns enabled=true, accepts only slot 0, and reports whether proposed values differ. No trait implementation in this file; callbacks are function pointers in adapter structs.
zircon_runtime/src/scene/tests/ecs_refle.documentation_decision: Added four comments only for adapter semantics that tests could otherwise mistake for real storage/removal: write callbacks are comparison-only, contains is entity-presence-only, remove does not mutate World, resource returns fixed values/no state. Existing module doc/helpers already explain broader purpose; simple constructors need no more docs.

zircon_runtime/src/scene/tests/ecs_refle.block_audit: Read all 693 original lines plus inserted comments. First test registers an actual descriptor in World and checks Json schema, role/flags, field order/type/editability; spawning an entity does not attach a dynamic component (adapter.contains false). Six source-shape guards read dynamic_component.rs or world_reflection.rs text and assert source structure/performance-shape substrings (descriptor Vec capacity+push, field constructor args, rsplit_once branch, dense bulk read allocation, direct property path constructor, direct success/error branches); they do not invoke those source functions. Runtime tests then check duplicate registration preflight/atomic counts; World facade read and schema-order field enumeration; changed versus idempotent JSON writes and generation; VM DynamicComponent writes same generation rule; read-only property rejection and no mutation; structured unknown type/stable ID field/missing-component errors; missing JSON key remains UnknownField; plugin unload remains blocked while instance exists; type-scoped, ordered rows and removal. Helpers construct descriptor/schema/address/field IDs and use manifest-dir source reading for shape tests. No unsafe, FFI, or proc-macro implementation appears in this file.
zircon_runtime/src/scene/tests/ecs_refle.documentation_decision: Added seven comments at high-information boundaries: distinguish descriptor registration from instance attachment, static source guards from runtime execution, schema order from JSON object order, one-time generation changes from idempotent writes, stable-ID error payload, missing declared JSON key behavior, and VM-backend generation contract. Remaining helper bodies/test assertions already state their test setup and expected result.
